text: He is Allah, glory be to Him and exalted, the Creator who decrees creation, the Originator who brings them into existence according to His wisdom, the Fashioner of His creation as He wills; to Him belong the most beautiful names and the highest attributes; all that is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him, and He is the Almighty, severe in retribution against His enemies, the Wise in managing the affairs of His creation.
